如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    车子转进一个弯，进入了一条私人道路，然后开进了一栋大别墅内。
每一次从这里转进去，沐如岚便不由得微微探头看着那块土地，仿佛看到了前世歪着脑袋躺在马路上没人理会的自己，她的嘴角笑容会加深，显得更加的温暖，没关系，我们自己给自己温暖，而且，我会让一些人下去陪你的，我们不会孤单的，好吗？
车门一开，沐如岚一下车就听到三楼小阳台，沐如森兴冲冲的朝她挥手，笑出很可爱的虎牙，“姐！姐！”他扬着手机，一只手激动的指着，小声的道：“手机号！我从别人手里拿到周雅雅的手机号了！”他一副‘我很厉害吧，姐姐快夸奖我’的可爱模样。
沐如岚不由得勾起温暖柔和的微笑，朝他摆了摆手，让他小心点别在栏杆处蹦蹦跳跳，随后便走了进去。
大厅内，沐震阳正坐在沙发上看报纸，柯婉晴在看电视，沐如岚微笑温柔的喊了声，“爸，妈，我回来了。”
两人抬起头，眼底齐齐露出笑意，柯婉晴站起身走过去接过她手上的书，眼底满满的骄傲，“改天跟那些老家伙说说，自己学校不自己管，让我宝贝女儿天天加班加点的，这像什么话！”
沐如岚顺势抱住柯婉晴的腰，柯婉晴穿着高跟鞋，长得也有一米七多，沐如岚脑袋便靠在她怀里，“妈，那你记得跟他们说说，给工资，月结的。”
沐震阳一听，顿时也乐了，“还没听过学校给权力还得给工资的。”
沐如岚眨眨眼，笑容中带了丝调皮，“那让叔叔爷爷们把奖学金包厚点呗，这几年我越长越大成绩越来越好，可是他们奖学金还小气吧啦的只有那么一点点呢，有赏有罚嘛，妈妈，你说是不是？”
这话听得沐震阳和柯婉晴心里舒服的不得了，这女儿从小到大都是他们的骄傲，别人只有羡慕嫉妒的份儿，每次跟他们聊天，只要把沐如岚的名字放出去，立刻就能引起一片惊呼赞叹声——
“啊，就是那个创下鎏斯兰学院十一年只要是大考成绩便是全国第一的沐如岚吗？”沐如岚从小学到初中到高中都是在鎏斯兰学院上的学，记录也从小学一年级保持到如今，十一年，从未落下，不是什么人都能做到这一点的。
“没想到竟然是你的孩子啊，太让人佩服了，你们的教育一定非常的完美！”总是有不认识柯婉晴和沐震阳却认识沐如岚的外省或者国外名媛贵族上流人士会来上这么一句。
“能够教出这样完美优秀的孩子，想必你们也一定非常的优秀，一定能够完美的完成这项工程，希望我们合作愉快！”偶尔她的名声也能带来这样充满利益的连锁反应。
“天啊！请一定和我们谈谈你们是如何教育出这样的孩子的，我家的小孩真的太不听话太皮了，如果能有沐如岚十分之一我也会高兴的睡不着觉的。”
“……”
如此如此，这般这般，柯婉晴和沐震阳的虚荣心得到了无与伦比前所未有过的满足，至少在K市G省，鲜少有人不知道沐如岚，所以人们对沐如岚的认识和名声，第一，是她那足够让国家高层都注意到的成绩，连续十一年，就算小学比较少人去在意，但是后面的初中高中，却不得不叫人在意，这样的成绩，高考还得下个学期呢，各大名门院校的校长便已经不少亲自拜访了沐家这两位，甚至连哈佛常春藤等一线名门都对沐如岚伸出了橄榄枝，这一切，沐如岚对外不提一字，柯婉晴和沐震阳却已经把它们传得沸沸扬扬。
沐如岚这辈子因为上辈子的事，性格扭曲了，变态了，连带着所做的各种事，也都理所当然了，不过如果柯婉晴和沐震阳知道，她现在那样温柔的满足他们所有的虚荣心和想要的一切荣耀，只是为了报答他们再一次把自己从肚子里生出来，然后到达她限定的报答底线之后，再把他们做成人偶，他们会怎么样呢？是宁愿继续这样无底洞的吸取着从她身上亮出的光芒虚华过后，进入棺材，还是被她丢尽颜面再苟延残喘的活下去呢？
唔……她估计，他们选择前者，所以，她继续放纵。
柯婉晴笑得艳光四射灿烂的仿佛开了花儿，她揉揉沐如岚的脑袋，“是是，我宝贝儿劳苦功高，奖学金得多点，零用钱也必须涨点！可不要太累了，知道吗？大不了我们不做会长了，那职位不要也没关系的，知道吗？”

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. The car turned a corner, entered a private road, and then drove into a large villa.
Every time she turned around from here, Mu Rulan couldn't help but look at the land slightly, as if she had seen herself lying on the road with her head tilted in her previous life, no one paying attention to her. The smile on her lips would deepen and appear warmer. It doesn't matter, we will keep ourselves warm, and I will let some people go down to accompany you. We won't be alone, okay?
As soon as the car door opened, Mu Rulan heard the small balcony on the third floor as soon as she got off the car. Mu Rusen waved to her excitedly, smiling with cute tiger teeth, "Sister! Sister!" He raised his mobile phone, pointed excitedly with one hand, and whispered: "Mobile phone number! I got Zhou Yaya's mobile phone number from someone else!" He had a cute look like 'I'm great, please praise me, sister!'
Mu Rulan couldn't help but raise a warm and gentle smile, waved her hand towards him, asking him to be careful not to jump around the railing, and then walked in.
In the hall, Mu Zhenyang was sitting on the sofa reading the newspaper, and Ke Wanqing was watching TV. Mu Rulan smiled and shouted softly, "Dad, Mom, I'm back."
The two of them raised their heads, with smiles in their eyes. Ke Wanqing stood up and walked over to take the book from her hand, her eyes full of pride, "I'll tell those old guys some other time. I don't care about my school, but let my precious daughter work overtime every day. What kind of talk is that!"
Mu Rulan hugged Ke Wanqing's waist. Ke Wanqing was wearing high heels and was over 1.7 meters tall. Mu Rulan rested her head in her arms, "Mom, remember to tell them that the salary will be paid monthly."
When Mu Zhenyang heard this, he immediately became happy, "I've never heard of a school giving power but also a salary."
Mu Rulan blinked, with a hint of naughtiness in her smile, "Then let uncles and grandfathers make the scholarship package thicker. In the past few years, I have grown older and my grades have gotten better and better, but their scholarship is still stingy. There is only a little bit of it. There are rewards and punishments, mom, don't you think so?"
Mu Zhenyang and Ke Wanqing felt extremely comfortable hearing these words. This daughter has been their pride since she was a child. Others can only envy and envy them. Every time they chat with them, just mentioning Mu Rulan's name will immediately arouse a chorus of exclamations and admiration——
"Ah, is that the Mu Rulan who set the record of being the first in the country in terms of college entrance examination results in the eleventh year of the Liusilan College?" Mu Rulan attended the Liusilan College from elementary school to junior high school and high school, and the record has been maintained from the first grade of elementary school to the present. For eleven years, it has never fallen behind. Not everyone can do this.
"I didn't expect to be your child. It's so admirable. Your education must be perfect!" There are always celebrities from other provinces or foreign countries who know Mu Rulan but don't know Ke Wanqing and Mu Zhenyang. They will say this.
"To be able to teach such perfect and outstanding children, you must also be very good, and you must be able to complete this project perfectly. I hope we can have a happy cooperation!" Occasionally, her reputation can bring about such a chain reaction full of benefits.
"Oh my God! Please tell us how you educate such children. My children are really disobedient and naughty. If I could have one tenth of Mu Rulan, I would be too happy to sleep."
"..."
So, so, so, Ke Wanqing and Mu Zhenyang's vanity has been satisfied like never before. At least in K City and G Province, few people don't know Mu Rulan, so people's recognition and reputation of Mu Rulan, first of all, are her results that are enough to attract the attention of the country's top officials. For eleven consecutive years, even if few people care about elementary school, people have to pay attention to the junior high school and high school. With such results, the college entrance examination has to be taken next semester.During this period, many presidents of prestigious colleges and universities had personally visited the two Mu family members, and even first-tier prestigious schools such as the Harvard Ivy League extended an olive branch to Mu Rulan. Mu Rulan did not mention a word about all this to the outside world, but Ke Wanqing and Mu Zhenyang had already spread it to the public.
Mu Rulan's personality has been distorted and abnormal because of what happened in her previous life, and all the things she has done are taken for granted. However, if Ke Wanqing and Mu Zhenyang know that she is so gentle to satisfy all their vanity and all the glory they want, just to repay them for giving birth to herself from the belly again, and then reaching her limited repayment bottom line, and then turning them into puppets, what will they do? Would you rather continue to absorb the light that shines from her body in this bottomless pit and then enter the coffin, or be humiliated by her and live on for a while?
Well... She guessed that they chose the former, so she continued to indulge.
Ke Wanqing smiled so brightly that it seemed like a flower had bloomed. She rubbed Mu Rulan's head, "Yes, my darling's hard work has paid off, so the scholarship will be better, and the pocket money must also be increased! Don't be too tired, you know? At the worst, we won't be the president of the president, and it doesn't matter if you don't want the position, you know?"
Little master, there will be more after this chapter ^.^, please click on the next page to continue. I like the rebirth of the master. It is too harsh, please.
